result.instructions: Tools for Teamwork.com, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tasks are due this week across all our projects?"; "Show me the open tasks assigned to Maria in the Website launch project."; "Log 90 minutes on the 'Write release notes' task for today.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Teamwork.com data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run teamwork_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run teamwork_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run teamwork_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. teamwork_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: teamwork_me
tools.title: Get the signed-in user
tools.description: Return the Teamwork person behind the API key (name, email, company, id). Use it to learn your own user id. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/me.json.

tools.name: teamwork_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects visible to the API key, with status, dates and company. Filter by search text. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/projects.json.

tools.name: teamwork_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by id: name, status, start and end dates, description and company. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}.json.

tools.name: teamwork_list_tasklists
tools.title: List task lists
tools.description: List task lists (the groups tasks sit in). Give project_id to list one project's lists, or leave it out for all visible lists. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}/tasklists.json or /projects/api/v3/tasklists.json.

project_id.description: Only the task lists of this project.

tools.name: teamwork_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks, with assignees, due dates and status. Give tasklist_id or project_id to narrow the list; tasklist_id wins when both are given. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/tasklists/{id}/tasks.json, /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}/tasks.json or /projects/api/v3/tasks.json.

tasklist_id.description: Only tasks in this task list.

assignee_user_ids.description: Only tasks assigned to these user ids.

due_after.description: Only tasks due on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

due_before.description: Only tasks due on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

tools.name: teamwork_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task by id: name, description, status, assignees, tasklist, start and due dates. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/tasks/{id}.json.

tools.name: teamwork_list_people
tools.title: List people
tools.description: List people (users) visible to the API key. Give project_id to list one project's members. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/people.json or /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}/people.json.

project_id.description: Only the members of this project.

tools.name: teamwork_list_timelogs
tools.title: List time entries
tools.description: List time entries (timelogs) with minutes, billable flag, user and date. Give task_id or project_id to narrow the list; task_id wins when both are given. Dates are inclusive. Teamwork API: GET /projects/api/v3/tasks/{id}/time.json, /projects/api/v3/projects/{id}/time.json or /projects/api/v3/time.json.

task_id.description: Only time entries on this task.

project_id.description: Only time entries on this project.

tools.name: teamwork_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task in a task list. Give a name and optionally a description and start and due dates. Teamwork API: POST /projects/api/v3/tasklists/{id}/tasks.json.

tasklist_id.description: The task list to create the task in.

tools.name: teamwork_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Change a task's name, description, start or due date, or move it to another task list. Only the fields you pass change. Teamwork API: PUT /projects/api/v3/tasks/{id}.json.

tasklist_id.description: Move the task to this task list.

tools.name: teamwork_complete_task
tools.title: Complete a task
tools.description: Mark a task as complete. Reverse it with teamwork_uncomplete_task. Teamwork API: PUT /tasks/{id}/complete.json.

tools.name: teamwork_uncomplete_task
tools.title: Reopen a task
tools.description: Mark a completed task as open again. Teamwork API: PUT /tasks/{id}/uncomplete.json.

tools.name: teamwork_create_timelog
tools.title: Log time on a task
tools.description: Add a time entry to a task for a day. Give hours, minutes or both. Teamwork API: POST /projects/api/v3/tasks/{id}/time.json.

description.description: What the time was spent on.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Teamwork.com
prompts.description: What you can do with Teamwork.com here, with example requests to try.
